items.title: Ford (F) Stock Looks Pricey Against Its Cash Flow Outlook
items.summary: Ford Motor has delivered mixed returns over different time frames, and recent headlines around electric vehicles, government support and new ventures now put a sharper spotlight on whether the current share price is in line with the cash the business can generate. For anyone looking at Ford stock today, the key issue is how those cash flows stack up against the valuation implied by the market. items.title: Ford (F) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Cut Targets On Cost And Execution Risk
items.summary: Ford Motor has seen its assessed fair value edge down from US$15.28 to about US$14.96 per share, which contributes to a slightly lower price target narrative. Recent research commentary links these trimmed targets of roughly US$1 to US$2 per share to concerns about execution risk, cost pressures, regulatory questions, and how reliably Ford can deliver on its 2027 plans.
